newsitem.title: GREECE: Athens stocks end up, resistance seen at 1,100pts.
newsitem.headline: Athens stocks end up, resistance seen at 1,100pts.

text.p: Greek stocks closed 2.53 percent higher in heavy volume with market watchers expecting the market momentum to last and placing the resistance level at 1,100 points.

"On Wednesday the bourse's performance was exceptional. The market trend is definitely upward and I expect it to last. We have no major corrections and I see a resistance share index level at 1,100 points,", said Apostolos Constantinides, fund manager at Hambros Hellenic Mutual Funds SA.
The Athens general share index jumped 2.53 percent or 26.38 points at 1070.01 from Tuesday's 1043.63, after opening at 1042.46.
Main investment interest was concentrated on blue chips and large capitalization stocks, he added.

"The Greek market has rallied since the beginning of 1997. Investors for whom stocks were only a small percentage of their portfolios, are on a day-to-day basis redirecting their funds into shares of all sectors," he said.
